## What lives here
The orchestration framework: the pipeline context, the layer and pipeline base classes, decision layers (`decide`), stages with rewind, SSE events, the spec models and the runtime helpers.

## Conventions
A layer does one job and calls `next`. Decisions go through `decision.decide` with model routes and fallback. Specs are Pydantic models.

## Entry points
`pipeline.Pipeline`, `decision.py`, `specs.py`, `context.PipelineContext` and `stages.py`.
